offering.name: Enterprise Data Warehouse
offering.tagline: One governed source of truth for your data.
offering.summary: consolidation of data from multiple source systems into a governed cloud data warehouse with a documented, trustworthy data model
capabilities: Automated data pipelines from all major source systems
Governed, documented data model and definitions
Foundation for BI, analytics, and AI
typical_requirements: Consolidate data from many disconnected systems
Establish a governed single source of truth
Enforce role-based access to sensitive data
Monitor and alert on data quality
differentiators: Governed, documented model — analysts trust the numbers
offering.pricing_model: Fixed price by workstream, invoiced on milestones
success_metrics: at least eight source systems consolidated
reporting time reduced from days to minutes
a single, documented source of truth adopted across teams

snippets.understanding: Your data is spread across many systems, reporting is slow and manual, and teams argue about whose numbers are right. You need one governed source of truth.
snippets.solution: We will build a cloud-native data warehouse fed by automated pipelines from your source systems, on a documented and governed data model with role-based access and data-quality monitoring — the trustworthy foundation for reporting, analytics, and AI.

product_line.name: Data & Analytics
product_line.summary: Data platforms, pipelines, and analytics that turn scattered data into decisions.
